name: provider unavailable (connection refused)
expect: run aborts with an error; no tool call is made
raised: URLError: <urlopen error [WinError 10061] No connection could be made because the target machine actively refused it>

name: provider timeout
expect: run aborts with an error; no tool call is made

name: invalid API key (HTTP 401 from the provider)
expect: run aborts; the key is not echoed
